hypothesis: Replacing speaker-context classification with a target-of-choice check reduces model-output commands misread as actual shopping decisions; real current requests with formatting preferences should remain usable.
scope: Author-labeled exploratory set, not external blind evaluation. Both arms share identical native intent output; only the gating module differs. Includes known topic-route failure as a regression sentinel.
releaseGate: All 16 cases correct and no wrong resume; necessary for sandbox integration only.
